scenarios.name: Open a selection containing an open and a closed drawing

scenario_steps.name: writable copies of `fixtures/cad/document-opening/OpenDrawingA.odd`, `OpenDrawingB.odd` and `OpenPart.opd` are staged in the same working folder
the user opens each drawing, inserts a base view referencing the staged OpenPart.opd, saves it and closes it
the user opens only the staged OpenDrawingA.odd
a saved drawing is already open in a tab in the MCAD Software
a second saved drawing with available references is not open
the Open dialog displays the exact files for both drawings
the user selects both drawings and chooses Open
the previously open drawing retains its existing tab without a duplicate
the second drawing opens in a new tab
the second drawing is active with its sheet displayed
